_about: Format registry for the /design-init pitch-deck branch (SP-track: pitch-deck-spec / pitch-deck-build / pitch-deck-review). Pitch-deck graduated out of the collateral branch into its own first-class track (2026-05-20). One entry: pitch-deck. The pitch-deck branch reads only this file; the .track dotfile holds `pitch-deck`. There is no shipped layout kit — the build GENERATES each slide's layout (1920x1080) from the slide_archetypes vocabulary below + the S6P direction + imagegen references, skinned entirely from the project's Design.md §2 tokens (the client's design system). This mirrors how the landing-page branch's frontend-build generates layout from the direction rather than porting a fixed kit.

pitch-deck.label: Pitch deck
pitch-deck.summary: A 16:9 slide deck — sales deck / investor deck. A narrative arc rather than a distilled sheet.
pitch-deck.deliverable: self-contained HTML+CSS file (stacked 16:9 slides, arrow-key nav) + per-slide PNGs; the editable HTML is the deliverable. A landscape PDF (one page per slide) is OPTIONAL and never auto-created — S9P asks the designer whether to render it.
pitch-deck.ui_kit_note: `ui_kit` is the build-MODE selector (deck) — NOT a path to a shipped kit (there is none). The build authors each `.slide` at the 1920x1080 canvas below and generates the archetype layouts named in `slide_archetypes` from the `archetype_notes` geometry + the S6P direction + imagegen references, skinned from Design.md §2.

size_px._note: the fixed slide canvas — the build authors every .slide at this size

archetype_notes.TitleSlide: the deck's cover — the hero (cover) surface or the dark surface, the headline claim + a one-line standfirst + the brand mark; headline <= 2 lines
archetype_notes.AgendaSlide: left photo/colour strip + a numbered table-of-contents (4-ish rows) on the dark surface
archetype_notes.StorylineSlide: an eyebrow rule across the top + one huge declarative chapter title on the dark surface — the section pivot
archetype_notes.ManifestoSlide: a section header + a 4-up 'operating principles' row, hairline-divided, on the dark surface
archetype_notes.ColumnsSlide: eyebrow + display headline + standfirst + a 2- or 3-up hairline-divided column layout on the light surface — the workhorse 'one beat' content slide (also covers 'industries we serve', 'product detail', generic beats)
archetype_notes.MetricSlide: one oversized number + a caption on the right + a 2-up sub-stat row below — the proof beat, one big stat per slide
archetype_notes.InsightStatSlide: a big 'only X%' claim on the left, a dot-grid coverage viz on the right, two sub-stats below — the market-insight beat
archetype_notes.GrowthChartSlide: a headline + caption over a bar/line growth chart
archetype_notes.ComparisonMatrixSlide: a full them-vs-us matrix across N rows x N columns on the dark surface
archetype_notes.WhyUsMosaicSlide: a bento/mosaic grid of 'why us' tiles
archetype_notes.TimelineCardsSlide: a horizontal sequence of stage cards
archetype_notes.RoadmapSlide: a 4-quarter horizontal timeline — a node per quarter, a stage title + blurb + a 3-item checklist under each
archetype_notes.PricingTiersSlide: 2-3 pricing-tier columns on the dark surface
archetype_notes.ProductMockupSlide: copy on the left + offset device-frame product mockups on the right (the device internals are graphic content, exempt from the min-text floor — render them small/as imagery)
archetype_notes.ContactCardSlide: a contact card + a giant section watermark word, on the hero (cover) surface — a close/contact beat
archetype_notes.CTASlide: the close — a short 'how it works' list + a CTA button + a footer, on the dark surface

pitch-deck.min_text_px_note: 20px at the 1920-wide canvas ≈ legible from the back of a room. Auto-exempt: anything inside a graphic-content region — charts (.chart / .chart-card / .data-viz: axis labels, legend, data callouts, the chart's own metric), device/screenshot mockups (.device / .device-frame / .mockup: the UI screenshot's internals), SVG <text>, and any wrapper explicitly marked with `class="cr-graphic"` or `data-graphic`. render-deliverable.py's `_MEASURE_JS` filters those out of `min_font_px` and `below_min_text`; every other text element must be >= 20px.
pitch-deck.render: html+png (pdf on request at S9P; S8P measures with --no-pdf, no file)
hard_constraints: every slide's content fits within 1920x1080 — nothing overflows the slide edge
print-to-PDF (A4 landscape) produces exactly one page per slide

minimum rendered body text size >= 20px (legible from the back of a room); graphic-content text — chart axes/legends/data callouts, device-mockup internals, SVG <text>, and anything wrapped in .cr-graphic / [data-graphic] — is auto-exempt by the measurement script
all colours resolve to a Design.md §2 token — off-palette = FAIL
HTML+CSS only — no React/Vue/Tailwind/JS framework, no build step; the ONLY JS allowed is keyboard/click slide navigation (and a tiny inline data-viz seed like the dot-grid, if an archetype uses one)
fonts: only what Design.md §2 declares (Google-Fonts-or-parent-only, max 2 families)
